notes: The list, including the queued items, already covers the authentic and doubtful solo sonatas and the Op. 2, Op. 5 and loose trio sonatas fairly completely. The main gap is the established Halvorsen violin-and-viola duos after Handel. Popular arrangements such as the Largo and the Flesch Prayer were left out because their arranger or edition could not be confirmed.
